scope: Every finite preorder with arbitrary nonnegative single-vertex activities and actual surviving disjoint-support degree at most three has an ultra-log-concave gamma sequence normalized by that actual degree. Arbitrary vertex count; vertex weight x_v is used for either role.
global_proof_checks: Positive vertex weights make actual degree equal physical comparability matching rank
Universal first gap and correct factor four at degree two
Finite closure through seven vertices, including disconnected, bipartite and total branches
GE graph reduction used only for its graph-theoretic content, not unweighted positivity statements
Canonical singleton exterior, no split equivalence classes, and fixed orientations
a=0 components have at most seven vertices; products need only low-rank real-rooted factors or one rank-three factor
a=1 pendant compression preserves vertex activities by assigning both unused/used roles the same sum
a=1 maximal seven-vertex core forces two rank-one triangles after attachment deletion
a=2 and a=3 use already approved independent-role theorems
Zero vertex activities are removed before applying the positive-activity theorem
Actual degree and ordered-support multiplicities retained throughout
documentation_clarification: The first-gap formula explicitly states d>=2.
not_claimed: The still-open complete independent-tail/head theorem at physical degree three
Real-rootedness for every vertex-weighted degree-three preorder
